item.title: Bulletin updated at 14:15 HKT 06/Dec/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon now affecting southern China will strengthen gradually tomorrow. It will be cool in the morning over the region early next week. With the monsoon moderating midweek next week, temperatures over the coast of Guangdong will rise slightly. Under the influence of another surge of the northeast monsoon, temperatures over the coast of southern China is expected to fall progressively in the latter part of next week. It will be cool in the morning and at night.
